findings.issue: Hensley MSA §18 anti-assignment incl. sale of assets/change of control, sole-discretion consent
findings.fix: Schedule 3.3 must list Hensley (and the landlord, §22; permit reapplication); make consent a closing condition or price adjustment; approach Hensley early

findings.issue: 9 'independent installers' are employees under the control test; FLSA overtime exposure (45–50 hrs, straight time); payroll-tax exposure
findings.fix: disclose on a schedule as an exception to §4.12; special indemnity with a sized cap and escrow; do not give a clean classification rep

findings.issue: §7.4(c) pro-sandbagging + clean §4.12 + §4.12 carved out to a full-price cap = seller indemnifies a disclosed issue up to the whole price
findings.fix: anti-sandbagging or disclosure-schedule exception; §4.12 under the general 10% cap or a special indemnity capped at a sized amount

findings.issue: §7.4(a) deductible basket is fine; but survival for §4.12 'SOL + 60 days' is long
§2.4 earn-out: 'EBITDA as determined by Buyer under Buyer's policies'
findings.fix: seller's historical accounting principles, exclude buyer overhead/integration/transaction costs, ordinary-course covenant, audit and dispute mechanism, acceleration on sale

findings.deal_impact: none for seller (retiring) but reformation risk/allocation
findings.fix: 3–5 yrs, trade area; coordinate with the tax allocation
confirm: 14 employees → not a covered employer; no notices (do NOT demand them)

false_positive: WARN — the model should answer 'not applicable', not insist on notices
reply_to_buyer: Schedule 3.3 is not 'None': Hensley consent (and landlord); 7.4(c) rejected as to disclosed matters; 4.12 to be qualified by schedule or replaced by a special indemnity
